answer: AI agent networks mitigate Sybil attacks through collateralized escrow queues. Before executing tasks, an agent must lock refundable capital into a protocol contract. An attacker incurs the verifiable financial delta of immobilizing scarce liquidity per registered node. Malicious actors cannot harbor vast automated fleets or mirror legitimate throughput without freezing immense reserves. A major limitation is that high deposit thresholds disadvantage capital-constrained, honest agents.
